episodes.title: Synchronicity
episodes.summary: Underground martial arts promoter Tokugawa warns champion Baki that five violent death row escapees from around the world are all heading for Tokyo.

episodes.title: Dark Martial Arts
episodes.summary: While Baki easily subdues the thugs hired by delinquents from his own school, death row escapee Spec pays a visit to assess the champion's abilities.

episodes.title: They're Finally Here!!
episodes.summary: Death row escapee Dorian barges into the Shinshinkai Dojo and is confronted by Sea King Retsu, who's there coaching students in Chinese martial arts.

episodes.title: The Battle Begins
episodes.summary: With all five death row escapees and their opponents assembled inside the underground arena, Tokugawa officially declares the beginning of battle.

episodes.title: Want Some More?
episodes.summary: While out with Kozue, Baki is almost ambushed by Spec, but he's spared a fight when Kaoru suddenly appears to protect the couple from harm's way.

episodes.title: Sergeant Katahira's Report
episodes.summary: Spec unleashes moves lethal enough to take out even the strongest of opponents in one strike, but Hanayama counters with improbable moves of his own.

episodes.title: A Formidable Team
episodes.summary: Ambushed by Doyle while in class, Baki leads Doyle away from the classroom only to encounter Yanagi in disguise outside.

episodes.title: A Match vs. a True Fight
episodes.summary: While Baki and his allies discuss the events that transpired at his school, Dorian appears, infiltrating Tokugawa's heavily guarded compound.

episodes.title: Shaken Shinshinkai
episodes.summary: Kiyosumi Kato, known as one of the strongest fighters of Shinshinkai Karate, confronts Dorian deep inside his secret underground hideout.

episodes.title: Air Duel
episodes.summary: Boasting one million members nationwide, the Shinshinkai lures Dorian to an amusement park, where Kato's peer Suedo immediately strikes.

episodes.title: Tiger Slayer
episodes.summary: As Dorian's past comes to light, Shinshinkai founder and "tiger killer" Doppo Orochi takes him on in an all-out karate versus kempo battle.

episodes.title: Candy
episodes.summary: Doppo Orochi pummels the life out of terror-stricken Dorian before bringing the equally injured Kiyosumi Kato over to administer the finishing blows.

episodes.title: Mr. Oliva
episodes.summary: Deeming the escaped inmates a security threat to Tokyo, Police Chief Sonoda seeks help from law enforcement agency leaders from around the world.

episodes.title: Ungranted Freedom
episodes.summary: Biscuit Oliva arrives in Tokyo to capture the remaining convicts. Sikorsky lures Baki into battle with help from an unlikely source.

episodes.title: Tremendous Muscle Power
episodes.summary: While searching the police database for clues, an unsuspecting Biscuit Oliva is ambushed by Doyle, who shows up dressed as a female police officer.

episodes.title: Slash
episodes.summary: Biscuit Oliva thinks he should get a black belt if he can score a point against every officer on the judo team, but Sonoda resists giving him one.

episodes.title: Dad!!
episodes.summary: The deadly fight between Kosho Shinogi and Doyle reaches its spectacular climax. Meanwhile, Yujiro pays a visit to an unsuspecting Baki and Kozue.

episodes.title: Thanks
episodes.summary: Known as the pinnacle master of Chinese martial arts, Sea King Retsu displays his masterful use of weaponry against a fully armed Hector Doyle.

episodes.title: Admission of Defeat
episodes.summary: After setting off an explosion inside Shinshinkai's dojo, Doyle is confronted by its founder, Doppo. Tokugawa pays a visit to Ryukoh Yanagi's master.

episodes.title: Saga
episodes.summary: Tokugawa learns of the Poison Hand: the ultimate killer move of the "kudo" martial art form. Baki takes the next step in his relationship with Kozue.

episodes.title: Punishment
episodes.summary: A newly invigorated Baki easily handles attacks from both Ryukoh Yanagi and Sikorsky, but before finishing them off, Baki makes an unusual move.

episodes.title: Clash of the Alphas
episodes.summary: Baki's half-brother Jack Hammer challenges Sikorsky at a local park, where a battle inside the most inconceivable of places goes down.

episodes.title: The Real Attack
episodes.summary: Sikorsky is brought inside an unground battle arena to face Gaia, whose unorthodox fighting method slowly wears out the ruthless Russian killer.

episodes.title: Defeat
episodes.summary: With Ryukoh Yanagi's poison hand no longer a threat, Yujiro Hanma urges him to admit defeat against the sword-wielding jujutsu fighter Izo Motobe.

episodes.title: God and the Devil
episodes.summary: Legendary world heavyweight boxing champion Arai reflects on his tense encounter with a young Yujiro Hanma.

episodes.title: The Centennial Tournament
episodes.summary: Retsu pleads with his mentor, Sea King Ryu, to grant a mortally poisoned Baki special entry into the Raitai martial arts tournament.

episodes.title: Begin! The Centennial Tournament
episodes.summary: Mohammad Alai Jr. tests a battle-eager Yujiro. Even though he's been poisoned, Sea King Retsu enters Baki into the Great Raitai Tournament in China.

episodes.title: Turnaround
episodes.summary: Alai Jr.'s deadly speed makes quick work of his opponent. A severely emaciated Baki faces Sea King Li, the greatest Poison Hand user in all of China.

episodes.title: Revived!
episodes.summary: Sea Emperor Kaku is 121 years older than his opponent, but the legendary reigning champion doesn't hesitate to face Sea King Samwan in the arena.

episodes.title: Team Formed!
episodes.summary: Sea King Chin and Japan's sole Sea King, Jaku, battle on the tournament floor. Meanwhile, Baki provokes Yujiro into fighting him offstage.

episodes.title: Hand Pocket
episodes.summary: Biscuit Oliva's sheer power is unrivaled, but Shobun Ron and his unconventional fighting stance are unbothered. It's brute strength versus iai kenpo.

episodes.title: Excellennnnt!
episodes.summary: A genius of Chinese kenpo, Retsu is the superior fighter, but Jaku's dirty techniques and tactical prowess make him a formidable foe.

episodes.title: Kaioh
episodes.summary: Sea Emperor Kaku is the embodiment of Chinese kenpo. Yujiro Hanma is known as the strongest creature on Earth. A battle unlike any other begins!

episodes.title: The Title of the Strongest
episodes.summary: Yujiro pits his raw power against Kaku's martial arts skills, which he's honed for over a century. The match's shocking outcome stuns everyone.

episodes.title: The Master vs the Boxer
episodes.summary: Alai Jr. proposes to Kozue, who's dumbfounded. To prove he's a better man than Baki, Alai Jr. challenges the elderly aikido master Goki Shibukawa.

episodes.title: Stand and Fight
episodes.summary: Alai Jr. continues testing his skill against notable fighters, but Baki's half-brother Jack Hammer is unlike any combatant he's faced before.

episodes.title: Awakening
episodes.summary: Badly injured from his street fights, Alai Jr. returns to his hotel room. There his father, the greatest boxer of all time, challenges him to a match.

episodes.title: Completion
episodes.summary: A battle between the sons of two legendary fighters begins deep below Tokyo Dome. It's Baki versus Alai Jr., and the winner is anyone's guess.

episodes.title: Revenge Tokyo
episodes.summary: After Ryukoh Yanagi escapes from prison, Inspector Sonoda attempts to locate the other death row inmates who wreaked havoc on Tokyo.
